text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Before we arrive on-site, I make a solemn 
vow to Boss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With things in the Twinkle Series finally 
winding down, I was heading with Fenomeno 
to the hot springs we won from the raffle, 
when on that very day...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"For today only, I shall be exceptionally 
lenient about all matters, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Serving justice with discipline! 
Naturally, my conviction doesn't have an 
off switch!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However! I just realized that dragging the 
Boss's vacation into this belief might not 
be the best idea, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—The other day, when the special episode 
of "Howl at the Full Moon!" aired, there 
was a line just like this!

text_block_list.name: Detective Actor
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even a hotshot detective's instincts'll 
get rusty if ya don't let 'em rest once in 
a while!’"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"For this officer, who is always keeping a 
watchful eye, that was a truly shocking 
statement!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I see... She is our boss, the very model 
of justice. To keep her instincts sharp, 
she must be enjoying her time off in a 
fitting manner."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"All right. On this next hot spring trip, 
I swear I won't drag you into my pace!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: And that is how it is, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This rare occasion of a hot springs trip! 
For the sake of the Boss's relaxation, I, 
the unworthy Fenomeno, shall remain 
thoroughly accommodating no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With such a passionate declaration, it was 
hard to say it wasn't needed... I decided 
to wait and see how things went for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Arrived on site! It appears to be a hot 
spring town scenery!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring you're looking for is over 
that way! The path is a bit tricky, so 
I'll guide you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus began our company trip. 
However... an unexpected pitfall awaited 
us.

text_block_list.name: Frivolous Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, it's their fault for not having 
trash cans~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Toss)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Littering—! No, but today I am on duty 
as...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: Ah... sorry, I just couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it is quite all right! Warning 
against littering is indeed the proper 
thing to do! That being said, however... 
hrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Frivolous Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No photography allowed here? Come on, 
just a little bit should be fine, right~?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! N-No, I have to take a deep breath 
first—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: B-Boss?

text_block_list.name: Frivolous Tourist C
text_block_list.text: Ah, a phone call! Helllooo!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
…………Um. Do you remember this officer's 
oath from today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, over the past few years, her 
sense of justice seems to have completely 
rubbed off on me. Before I even realized 
it, I was already taking action."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Telling her that I would be more careful 
next time, I headed to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for waiting, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There is an insolent rascal tearing apart 
the yuzu in the yuzu bath and playing with 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My thunderous shout is sealed today, so 
cleaning up by myself before heading out 
took a bit of extra time, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――? Boss, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, soaking in the hot spring gave 
me time to think anew. About the current 
state of Fenomeno holding back his sense 
of justice for the sake of his own 
comfort.
choice_data_list:
I know it's late to say this, but I want 
you to just be your usual self.

I know it's late to say this, but I want 
you to just be your usual self.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno's pure-hearted nature is truly 
rare. She naturally holds on to the 
innocence that most people shed as they 
grow up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after weathering the rough seas of 
the Twinkle Series, it never once wavered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, the reason she 
grew attached to me was probably a 
misconception that I was a fine person 
with a sense of justice. But—"
choice_data_list:
I'm not as pure and innocent as you think 
I am.

I'm not as pure and innocent as you think 
I am.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true at all! Over these past 
few years, you've supported me more times 
than I can count!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I have been inspired by your justice 
countless times, and it has made me stand 
tall!
choice_data_list: You're the one who made me this way.
That's because you made me this way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being exposed to her sense of justice 
must have naturally straightened my own 
posture as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To the point where I reflexively scold 
someone for littering or bad manners.
choice_data_list:
So please, don't compromise that sense of 
justice.

So please don't compromise that sense of 
justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...This officer cannot believe it. I can 
only see it... as mere encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However... if that is truly the case. If I 
was able to serve as even a fraction of 
justice for you—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: There could be no greater compliment...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Well then!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to retract my vow! Today as 
well, I shall purely, righteously uphold 
justice, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now that that is decided— please wait a 
moment!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno narrowed her eyes sharply, locked 
onto her target, and dashed forward at top 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Heeey! Stop right there, tourist who just 
littered!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a precious moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Fenomeno...
